1934, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 185 Cont.
Apr. 5
Henry Pfeifer - 50 - Heart trouble
6th Mrs. Anna Resico - 68 - cancer of breast removed last August, was better for time, now worse than ever. Has daughter married out of Church to bitter unbeliever, yet he permits his wife to go to Church when they come - giving them the Auto for the 9 mi. drive - Enrolled To-day.
James Campbell - 47 - drinking, neglecting Church .... Holy Com. once in yr.
Ray Dillon - 35 - non cath. away from Catholic Wife .... Heart sick. Mrs. Florida Vanneck - 62 -?? W. yellow ..
Leo Reilly.
Nellie Krack .... 50 .... $85 to spiritists - getting worse all the time.
Mrs. Loeckner - 414 Scanore - $5 for woman, widow housekeeper
10 Alex Brachulis - 42 - a policeman now on back - till just recently - since last June - kidney trouble - wife not catholic ...
Wm. Mugbeck for 3 years away from Easter duty.
Page 186 Apr. 10 Walter Maciejewski - 43 - Wednesday - To-morrow operation , tumor on brain, Enrolled by phone at 9 P.M.
Joice Snodgrass - 15 - going blind since Jan. Febr. 15 was in Hosp., was to stay there 3 months. prayed for her about that time - Home now after 7 weeks.
Garland & Blake Co. .
Lester & Mr.
Louise Geheb - 19 - twin goiter.
Mrs. A, C, Milne - 46 - like rhum. - nusband not cath.
Consuelo Evans - 36 - Husb. & 2 - cancer .. Enrolled 3 weeks ago. Now though gangreenous very much pain is gone. .
Her sister needs work - husband ailing.
